initial_outreach.name: Initial Outreach
initial_outreach.body: Hi {first_name}, thank you for connecting! I noticed your work and would love to exchange insights on modern workflow automation whenever convenient for you.

interested_reply.name: Interested Reply
interested_reply.body: Hi {first_name}, glad to hear you are interested! Would you be open to a brief 10-minute chat later this week to explore this further?

request_more_info.name: Request for More Information
request_more_info.body: Hi {first_name}, here is a quick overview of how we streamline messaging and tracking workflows. Let me know if you would like me to share a detailed deck.

not_interested.name: Not Interested
not_interested.body: Hi {first_name}, completely understand! Thank you for letting me know, and I wish you all the best with your ongoing initiatives.

unclear_reply.name: Unclear Reply
unclear_reply.body: Hi {first_name}, thanks for getting back to me! Just to ensure I understand your goal, could you clarify what you have in mind?

five_day_followup.name: Five-Day Follow-up
five_day_followup.body: Hi {first_name}, just following up on my previous note in case it got buried. No rush at all—would love to reconnect when your schedule permits!
